name: WebDataStudio
description: A database studio that runs in your browser: PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, DuckDB, ClickHouse, MongoDB and Redis in one container. Schema explorer, SQL editor with completion and history, a visual query builder, result charts, ER diagrams drawn from the foreign keys, schema editing, a column-by-column comparison between two connections, saved and scheduled queries with file export, and an MCP endpoint for AI agents. Connections are added in the studio or handed in as WDS_CONN_NAME variables. Set the admin user and password below - without both, the studio has no login screen at all. Read-only connections are enforced in the driver, not only in the interface.
